query: create vlan 100 on sonic-vs-1, no SVI needed
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - VLAN-E-01
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo
  tasks:
  - name: Add VLAN100 on SONiC-VS-1
    raw: config vlan add 100
    when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
    ignore_errors: true

  - name: Verify VLAN100 exists
    raw: show vlan brief | grep -w 100
    when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
    register: vlan_check
    failed_when: vlan_check.rc != 0 or vlan_check.stdout == ''
    changed_when: false

  - name: Save config on SONiC-VS-1
    raw: sudo config save -y
    when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
